sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Loads the React tools for remembering values and running timed actions, and marks the file to run in the visitor's browser.
sections.why: The logo blinks and reacts to the mouse, which needs browser code.

sections.name: GokuLogo (part 1)
sections.title: Hover state, blink timer, and glow setup
sections.what: Stores whether the mouse is over the logo and whether the eyes are closed. Runs a timer that blinks every three to six seconds, or every two seconds while hovered, and defines the aura and glow effects.
sections.why: Makes the logo feel alive while staying subtle. The different timing when hovered is visible in the code.
sections.watch_out: The main timer is cleared when hover changes, but the short timers that reopen the eyes are not cleared, so they can fire after the logo is removed.

sections.name: GokuLogo (part 2)
sections.title: Eyelids and aura drawing
sections.what: Draws the glowing aura behind the cat and the two eyelid shapes that move down to close the eyes during a blink.
sections.why: Likely reason: a blink is done by moving a hidden shape over the eyes, rather than redrawing the eyes.
sections.watch_out: Gradient, filter, and clip shape names are shared across the whole page, so placing this logo twice could cause clashes.

sections.name: GokuLogo (part 3)
sections.title: Cat body, eyes, and tail
sections.what: Draws the black cat head, ears, and body, the white eyes clipped by the eyelids, and a tail that curves a little further up when hovered.
sections.why: Likely reason: the tail movement gives visible feedback that the logo is responding to the mouse.

summary: A small animated cat face logo that blinks on a timer and reacts to the mouse hovering over it.
purpose: Shows the brand mark next to the site name, with a lively blink and a small tail movement on hover.
why: Likely reason: to give the brand a friendly, animated feel. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Tracks whether the mouse is over the logo and whether the eyes are closed. Starts a repeating timer that closes the eyes briefly, faster when hovered. Draws the cat shape with glow and aura effects, and moves eyelid shapes over the eyes during a blink.
inputs: An optional size class name from the parent component, and mouse enter and leave events.
outputs: A drawn logo that blinks and changes its tail curve when hovered.
risks: Shape and effect names are shared across the whole page, so two logos on one page could interfere with each other. Short timers that reopen the eyes are not cleared when the logo leaves the screen.
debug: If the logo stops blinking, check the hover state and the blink timer in this file. If the browser console warns about updates after removal, look at the timers that are not cleared. If the logo looks wrong in size, check the size class passed in by the parent.
